## Optional original ONE-owner external x402 merchant resources
These are the actual already-published ORIGINAL VM5 endpoints. No new
gateway or seller identity is created by this root machine-readable guide.

- POST https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-preflight
  Price: **0.005000 native Circle USDC**, network **eip155:8453** (Base);
  official contract **0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4C7C32D4f71b54bdA02913**.
  It takes JSON with a required csvText string. A FREE unsigned HTTP402 quote
  can be reproduced only with a wholly fictional payload and no wallet:
  https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/docs/CSV_005_UNPAID_BUYER_VERIFICATION_20261021.md
  Buyer-controlled optional paid browser UX:
  https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/csv-usdc-checkout.html .
  Current browser price checker transmits ONLY fixed fictional rows before a
  separately consented and buyer-signed paid POST. No independent buyer-owned
  paid CSV POST delivery or settlement was verified as of 2026-10-21.
- GET https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-report
  Original x402 v2 exact price **0.005000 native Circle Base USDC**;
  publicly verified unsigned GET HTTP402. A 402 challenge is NOT a paid
  response, buy order, verified invoice or a future-price guarantee.
- GET https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/ping
  Original x402 v2 exact price **0.001000 native Circle Base USDC**;
  original unsigned GET HTTP402, no independent payment inferred from the
  quote.

- x402 PRICE = stated public quote only. No unprompted payment, no wallet
